composition: Engadin lakeshore looking across Lake St. Moritz toward the town and peaks · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Lake St. Moritz fills the foreground, with the town climbing the slope and high Engadin peaks behind it. Late September here is early autumn: larches are still mostly green with only the first gold, and the town is not under winter snow. Residual snow is limited to the higher summits. The Open-Meteo model for this high cell is fully overcast.
